reasoning_traces.think:
The trust-target profile primitive encodes probabilistic mappings between quarterbacks and receivers under varying absence conditions, enabling dynamic inference of target likelihoods. It leverages empirical data from StatRankings and FantasyPtsData to compute conditional probabilities P(target=t|QB,situation), which are then used in conjunction with TD decomposition to assess target quality. The QB behavioral feature recipe provides a structured set of metrics—first-read rate, scramble rate, pressure EPA/db—that are cross-referenced with team playcalling and coaching priors to generate predictive behavioral kernels. These features are validated through walk-forward testing and integrated into GSE’s state-transition logic. The half-life band calibration ensures that forecasts maintain calibrated uncertainty bounds, particularly for QBs whose volatility is poorly captured by static models. Together, these primitives form a coherent framework for probabilistic inference in fantasy and DFS contexts, grounded in validated regression techniques and cross-layer consistency checks.
